# Smile Studio Dental

> A comprehensive Denver dental practice offering cosmetic, restorative, and preventative care from three experienced dentists.

Smile Studio Dental is a full-service dental practice in Denver, Colorado, led by Dr. Rana Sweis, Dr. Adam Gart, and Dr. Ishita Topiwala. The practice specializes in family dentistry, cosmetic procedures, dental implants, and preventative care with patient-focused amenities and a modern clinical environment.

## Dental Services

- [Comprehensive Dental Services | Smile Studio Dental - Denver](https://www.smilestudiodenver.com/denver-co/dental-services): Overview of comprehensive dental services including Invisalign and cosmetic dentistry
- [Preventative Dental Care in Denver | Smile Studio Dental - Denver](https://www.smilestudiodenver.com/denver-co/preventative-dental-care): Preventative dental care services including cleanings and sealants
- [Bi-annual Teeth Cleaning | Smile Studio Dental - Denver](https://www.smilestudiodenver.com/denver-co/bi-annual-teeth-cleaning): Bi-annual professional teeth cleaning and checkup services
- [Deep Cleaning for Gum Disease Treatment | Smile Studio Dental](https://www.smilestudiodenver.com/denver-co/deep-cleaning): Scaling and root planing treatment for gingivitis and periodontitis
- [Gum Disease Detection & Treatment | Smile Studio Dental](https://www.smilestudiodenver.com/denver-co/gum-disease-detection): Gum disease detection and treatment for gingivitis and periodontitis
- [Dental Sealants | Smile Studio Dental - Denver](https://www.smilestudiodenver.com/denver-co/dental-sealants): Dental sealant services for cavity prevention and molar protection
- [Flouride Treatment | Smile Studio Dental - Denver](https://www.smilestudiodenver.com/denver-co/flouride-treatment): Fluoride treatment to strengthen teeth and prevent cavities
